# opnsense_nginx_cache_path (Resource)

nginx cache paths (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ Cache Path**, plugin `os-nginx`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_cache_path" "static" {
  path     = "/var/cache/nginx/static"
  size     = 10
  inactive = 60
  max_size = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Path.

### Optional

- `inactive` (Number) Inactive Time (Minutes). Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum Size (GB). Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `size` (Number) Size (MB). Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `use_temp_path` (Boolean) Use Temp Path. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx cache path.
